ingress_default_deny_enforced.title: Ingress Default-Deny Enforced
ingress_default_deny_enforced.description: Inbound ruleset terminates in deny-all; only an explicit allow-list permits traffic. Secure true.

egress_default_deny_enforced.title: Egress Default-Deny Enforced
egress_default_deny_enforced.description: Outbound traffic defaults to deny with a scoped egress allow-list. Secure true.

least_privilege_rules_scoped.title: Least-Privilege Rules Scoped
least_privilege_rules_scoped.description: Allow rules name specific source/destination/port/protocol tied to a business need. Secure true.

no_any_any_permit_rules.title: No Any/Any Permit Rules
no_any_any_permit_rules.description: No any/any or any-service permit rules exist in the ruleset. Secure true.

interface_acls_enforce_segmentation.title: Interface ACLs Enforce Segmentation
interface_acls_enforce_segmentation.description: Trust zones are separated by the firewall at path splits via interface ACLs. Secure true.

east_west_microsegmentation_enforced.title: East-West Microsegmentation Enforced
east_west_microsegmentation_enforced.description: Inter-segment (east-west) traffic is filtered; SMB/RDP/WinRM blocked without business need. Secure true.

security_profiles_on_allow_rules.title: Security Profiles on Allow Rules
security_profiles_on_allow_rules.description: Allow rules carry threat-prevention / IPS / AV / URL inspection profiles. Secure true.

ips_threat_prevention_enabled.title: IPS / Threat-Prevention Enabled
ips_threat_prevention_enabled.description: The IPS / threat-prevention engine is enabled on the firewall. Secure true.

denied_traffic_logging_enabled.title: Denied Traffic Logging Enabled
denied_traffic_logging_enabled.description: Denied and security-relevant allowed traffic is logged off-box to a SIEM. Secure true.

implicit_deny_logged.title: Implicit Deny Logged
implicit_deny_logged.description: The implicit deny-all rule logs dropped traffic. Secure true.

firewall_ruleset_documented_and_owned.title: Ruleset Documented and Owned
firewall_ruleset_documented_and_owned.description: Ruleset is documented from risk analysis with each rule owned and justified. Secure true.

firewall_rules_recertified_on_cadence.title: Rules Recertified on Cadence
firewall_rules_recertified_on_cadence.description: Rules are reviewed on a defined cadence; stale and shadowed rules are removed. Secure true.

firewall_change_control_enforced.title: Change Control Enforced
firewall_change_control_enforced.description: Rule changes pass approved change control with security-impact analysis. Secure true.

edge_management_interfaces_not_internet_.title: Management Plane Not Internet-Reachable
edge_management_interfaces_not_internet_.description: Admin/management interface restricted to permitted-IP / management network, plaintext disabled. Secure true.

edge_appliance_patched_within_sla.title: Appliance Patched Within SLA
edge_appliance_patched_within_sla.description: Firewall firmware is patch-current with no known-exploited pre-auth CVEs. Secure true.
